integrity: All finite face collapses and integral signed chain pivots are recorded as exact integer data and independently replayed; finite-field ranks are an additional check, not a substitute for integral proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified Paley tournament of order 19 and its indicated affine subgroup are treated; no prime-uniform statement and no integral quotient-homology classification.
title: Mixed-dimensional homotopy and affine character of the Paley-19 out-neighborhood complex
